title: AnonInsight
tagline: Conduct rating surveys or polls anonymously on any web3/web2 app using our widget. Protect user privacy while gathering valuable insights!
description: Introducing our innovative project, designed to revolutionize feedback collection: An Anonymous Feedback Platform with domain verification. Seamlessly integrating Bandada, Semaphore, and Proof of Email, our versatile tool ensures that only verified email domains can provide anonymous feedback. In the backend, we leverage Zk-email regex functionality, powered by the Sindri API key, to dynamically generate circuits based on provided patterns. With automated Sindri deployment, circuit IDs are returned to the admin dashboard, facilitating easy form creation using our SDK.
how_its_made: Our project introduces an innovative survey SDK that prioritizes user privacy and data security, leveraging a combination of Scroll, Bandada, MACI, and Aztec's Noir language. The SDK enables organizations to create anonymous surveys with secure data in Scroll. Bandada manages anonymous user groups, ensuring respondent anonymity, while MACI  is used to achieve anonymous polling. Aztec's Noir language facilitates encrypted data analysis, guaranteeing user privacy throughout the survey process. This SDK empowers organizations to gather valuable insights while upholding the highest standards of user privacy and data security.
